selection: Keep complete lines wholly inside each fixed byte range, excluding the header. Reset model context at each slice. Each slice is evaluated separately.
excluded_rows: Count repeated headers and rows missing a timestamp, label or finite required numeric measurements. Never substitute values. Other schema violations invalidate the run.
comparator: Sum of forward and backward packets. Compare both rankings on the same top floor(1% of scorable flows) per slice; break ties by source order.
labels: Benign is negative. All other publisher attack labels are positive; report each separately.
